snippet.title: PIPELINE | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
PIPELINE is a 1-6 player online co-op, physics-based, action FPS, rogue-lite where every bullet counts. Progress levels, ride around in the shopping cart, discover game-altering upgrades, get strong, fight even stronger enemies. Death is not the end. The cycle will repeat.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265340/PIPELINE/
